title: Show HN: Attaching to a virtual GPU over TCP

items.summary: Exciting. But would definitely like to see a self hosted option.
Access serverless GPUs through a simple CLI to run your existing code on the cloud while being billed precisely for usage. However, it's not supported on Mac and the connection method is unclear.
Does this work for gaming on Windows or Linux?
What ML packages do you support? Does it support Vulkan or OpenGL and AMD GPUs?
Is there a self-hosting option to use the GPUs I already have?
What's the pricing model? How can I determine the cost without creating an account?
It's not clear how the tool and service connect and expose eGPU capabilities.
This could be perfect for us. We need very limited bandwidth but have high compute needs.
The network connection could be a bottleneck for high throughput tasks.
The network connection might cause issues with GPU drivers.
